identity_policy: UUIDv5 values are minted once under the batch identity namespace, committed to this artifact and thereafter immutable. Do not regenerate from future names or URLs. Existing dataset contained no staged ship records at research start. Before production import, compare with live canonical catalog including official identifiers; this batch does not authorize an upsert by name.
as_of_policy: checked_at/as_of is the UTC review date, not a claim that the operator published/updated every underlying fact that day. Historical document issue dates appear in observations. Operating means offered as a current operating fleet member, not live vessel tracking or confirmed cabin inventory.
unknown_policy: No inferred occupancy basis, restaurant/shop totals, deck totals, build year from debut, or licenses. Missing facts are explicit null/unverified; conflicts remain hidden. Venue/cabin source dates inherit their referenced source checked_at and are repeated in field_evidence.

selection_changes.reason: Current fleet listing available, but detailed Envision page could not be retrieved; use directly verifiable ship-specific source for first batch. Avalon remains an operator research lead.
